lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct high-contrast vertical white line segments; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso (approx. 25-30 pixels) with increased frequency and compression observed towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most vertical line terminates abruptly in the upper quadrant of the torso. The 9th posterior-most line is fragmented into a series of three vertically-aligned spots.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density grouping of approximately 14 discrete white spots localized on the upper hindquarters and lateral haunch region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper-mid thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal band visible across the lower ventral neck/brisket. White distal patches present on all visible limbs above the hoof line.
